title: Trades
label: Trade Tracker
subtitle: Official LSL trades and player movement for the active season.

transactions.summary: Leeward Lions acquired Zaid Badin and Ibrahim Kadam. Gangat Warriors acquired Byram Loukil and Umar Manjra.

receives.name: Zaid Badin
receives.note: Moved from Memon Mavericks to Leeward Lions.

receives.name: Ibrahim Kadam
receives.note: Moved from Gangat Warriors to Leeward Lions.

receives.name: Byram Loukil
receives.note: Moved from Leeward Lions to Gangat Warriors.

receives.name: Umar Manjra
receives.note: Moved from Leeward Lions to Gangat Warriors.

impact: Leeward Lions add two roster pieces while keeping their main leadership group intact.
Gangat Warriors bring in Byram Loukil and Umar Manjra as they look for a response after a tough stretch.
The move changes the senior playoff race because both teams are fighting for position.

receives.name: Roster claim

transactions.summary: Refuel Rovers acquired Abdul Ghiyas Solyman from EM Haulers FC. EM Haulers FC acquired Mohammed Wahedi from Refuel Rovers.

receives.name: Abdul Ghiyas Solyman
receives.note: Two goals and one assist in Week 1 before the trade.

receives.name: Mohammed Wahedi
receives.note: Adds another flexible roster piece for EM Haulers FC.

impact: Refuel Rovers add a proven scorer after opening the season with one goal.
EM Haulers FC keep their strong attacking core while adding Mohammed Wahedi.
This move changes the Week 2 roster picture before Refuel Rovers face Amax Visionaries.

transactions.summary: Amax Visionaries acquired Adil Mubashir from Sharp Strikers. Sharp Strikers acquired Jamal Mujaddidi from Amax Visionaries.

receives.name: Adil Mubashir
receives.note: Gives Amax a new option after a difficult Week 1 loss.

receives.name: Jamal Mujaddidi
receives.note: Adds depth to a Sharp Strikers team that started the season with a win.

impact: Amax Visionaries respond to their Week 1 defensive problems with a roster change.
Sharp Strikers stay aggressive after a strong opening result.
Both teams get a fresh look before the Week 2 schedule.
